TO REST AT MIDNIGHT
end: The Midnight Watch — stand in prayer at midnight

scenes.a: Your heavy mind refuses to rest tonight.
scenes.sub: WHEN YOUR MIND REFUSES TO REST

scenes.a: You lie awake in the dark, wondering who guards your life when your human strength runs dry.
He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.
scenes.sub: HE WILL NOT SUFFER THEE TO MOVE

scenes.a: Behold, he that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.
Lord, anchor our weary feet in this quiet space when fear and exhaustion threaten to overturn us.
Guard our restless thoughts with your holy presence, for your watchful eyes never close or grow tired.
scenes.sub: HIS EYES NEVER CLOSE IN SLEEP

scenes.a: Keep watch over every hidden fear tonight, Amen, even when your heavy mind refuses to rest.
scenes.sub: KEEP WATCH OVER OUR HIDDEN FEARS
